arStrings.szText: Casting {c_important}Ball Lightning{/c} instead creates a separate static field around you that damages all enemies within for {c_random}[Affix_Value_1* 100|%|]{/c} of {c_important}Ball Lightning's{/c} damage per active ball. You are {c_important} {u}Unhindered{/u}{/c} as long as the field is active.
